column2: [intro]
In my glass, I’ve put some ginger,
A bitter taste that makes me linger.
I drink, I drink, without understanding,
Ginger liqueur, it’s so commanding.
Ginger liqueur, oh what splendor,
Gives me wings, makes me tender.
Ginger liqueur, brings me bliss,
I laugh, I cry, can't resist this.
In my dreams, all is chaos,
Ginger has made its own accords.
I walk, I fall, break records,
Ginger liqueur, it transports.
Ginger liqueur, I can't resist,
Makes me forget all that exists.
Ginger liqueur, when it haunts,
I laugh, I sing, it enchants.
[ solo ]
Ginger liqueur, I'll love you always,
With you, I’m free, in endless ways.
Ginger liqueur, in my heart and words,
I dance, I sing, like flying birds.
[ outro ]
